title: City bicycle wheels
author: Innerscene
note: Innerscene's CC0 city bicycle with nominal 700 mm tires, viewed side-on along the wheel axles. Both wheels rotate together at the dataset's illustrative angular speed; the bicycle is shown coasting, so the freewheel allows the cassette, chain and pedals to remain still. The frame is held in place for comparison rather than translated along a road. This is a nominal-scale visualization, not manufacturer CAD or a rated speed for a specific bicycle.

steps: scripts/rig_city_bicycle.py groups existing hub, rim, tire and spoke meshes around the original front/rear hub centers, preserving all rest transforms and mesh buffers.
No new mesh, texture, subdivision or decoder dependency. Frame and drivetrain stay in a separate fixed Housing group.
